Bill.BriefDescription: Providing training for new county officers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to training for newly elected county officers; andadding a new section to chapter 36.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Expenses incurred by a newly elected county officer before takingoffice that relate to a course of training and education pertaining tothe administration and operations of county government, including thereasonable costs of housing, travel, and meals, may be paid from publicfunds appropriated for those purposes. All expenses not paid for bystate funds may be paid from funds of the county where that officialwas elected or appointed.
